input_fields.name: current_document_or_component
input_fields.description: Current document or one explicitly selected component whose body scope is to be enumerated.

result_fields.name: body_collection
result_fields.description: Current bodies in the declared scope, each with stable object identity and semantic properties.

result_fields.name: enumeration_scope
result_fields.description: Document/component scope and enumeration mode used.

procedure: Bind the read to current_document_or_component and record whether direct or descendant bodies are requested.
Enumerate the current collection once and return each body identity without using a recorded ordinal alias.
Return enumeration_scope with the source document/component and collection kind.
Leave all geometry, names, selection, and visibility unchanged.
rejection_rules: Reject an ambiguous document/component or an unspecified direct-versus-descendant scope.
Reject a collection that cannot be tied to the current document/component.
Do not turn this action into a count, measurement, name, or visual-review workflow.
